en.basel-kadem: 1.	My father, may Allah grant him mercy, said: We were told by Muhammed bin Yahya, that he said: We were told by Muhammed bin Ahmad bin Yahya al-Ash’ari, that he said: We were told by Ali bin Ibrahim al-Manqari, or another, who ascribed it, saying: Al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:
Indeed, from an individual’s happiness is the lightness of his two opposites.
He said: There is no happiness in this. The happiness is only in the lightness of his two chewers by (which he can perform) glorification (of Allah).
